jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Trabajo Remoto
jobs.description:
En BairesDev® llevamos 15 años liderando proyectos de tecnología para clientes como Google, Rolls-Royce y las startups más innovadoras de Silicon Valley. Actualmente, contamos con un equipo de 4000 profesionales conformado por el top 1% de la industria trabajando de forma remota desde más de 50 países.

Al postularte a esta vacante, estarás dando el primer paso en un proceso que va más allá de lo convencional: Buscaremos conocer en profundidad tus habilidades, intereses y expectativas con el objetivo de realizar una búsqueda personalizada y encontrar el rol ideal para ti en BairesDev.

Technical Project Manager en BairesDev

Lidera proyectos técnicos desde la planificación hasta la entrega garantizando alineación entre equipos técnicos y objetivos de negocio. Este rol se enfoca en la gestión de ciclos de vida de proyectos, coordinación de equipos multifuncionales y aplicación de conocimiento técnico y expertise en gestión de proyectos para impulsar resultados exitosos.
Qué Harás:
- Planificar, ejecutar y monitorear proyectos técnicos garantizando entrega a tiempo dentro del alcance y presupuesto.
- Coordinar equipos multifuncionales incluyendo desarrolladores, diseñadores y stakeholders.
- Gestionar riesgos, dependencias y cronogramas de proyectos manteniendo comunicación clara.
- Facilitar ceremonias ágiles y garantizar que los equipos sigan mejores prácticas para entrega de proyectos.
- Dar seguimiento al progreso de proyectos y brindar actualizaciones regulares a stakeholders y liderazgo.
- Hacer el puente entre perspectivas técnicas y de negocio para garantizar resultados exitosos de proyectos.

Qué Buscamos:

- 3+ años de experiencia en gestión de proyectos técnicos o roles relacionados.
- Sólida comprensión de procesos de desarrollo de software y conceptos técnicos.
- Experiencia con metodologías ágiles y herramientas de gestión de proyectos.
- Capacidad comprobada de gestionar múltiples proyectos y priorizar demandas concurrentes.
- Fuertes habilidades de comunicación y gestión de stakeholders.
- Nivel avanzado de inglés.

Qué ofrecemos para que tu trabajo (y tu vida) sea más fácil:

- Trabajo 100% remoto: trabaja desde tu casa o donde quieras.
- Compensación en USD o en tu moneda local, como prefieras, muy por encima de la media del mercado.
- Hardware y software.
- Horarios flexibles
- Licencias por mater/paternidad, vacaciones y días festivos nacionales pagos.
- Ambiente laboral multicultural e innovador, perfecto para hacer amigos, colaborar y aprender de las personas más talentosas del mundo.
- Oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional a través de mentorías y entrenamientos.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo global!

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Business Project Managers and IT Project Managers
to support cross-functional teams and ensure seamless execution of project workflows using Azure DevOps.
This role is pivotal in driving team alignment, maintaining visibility into progress, and fostering consistent project management practices. The ideal candidate is a natural collaborator with strong communication skills, capable of facilitating stand-ups and meetings, identifying blockers, and keeping stakeholders informed through clear reporting. If you are detail-oriented and passionate about enabling teams to deliver high-quality work on time, we’d love to meet you.

This position is a night shift work-from-home position with a usual schedule of 9am EST - 6pm EST.

Responsibilities
(include but are not limited to the following):
Manage project timelines, deliverables, and department-specific task boards using Azure DevOps
Coordinate tasks and resources across multiple teams to ensure alignment with goals and deadlines
Support development teams by facilitating stand-ups, meetings, and follow-ups
Serve as a key point of contact for internal teams, maintaining smooth communication and progress tracking
Ensure team boards are up to date and clearly reflect current priorities and status
Assist in planning, deployment, and handover of completed work, including documentation and scheduling
Help identify risks, delays, and blockers, and work with leaders to resolve them
Prepare simple reports and updates for management on team/project progress
Champion consistency in work management practices and drive team collaboration
Guide teams in applying basic Agile principles to improve workflow and delivery

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, IT, Legal Studies, or related field—or equivalent experience
Minimum 4 years of experience in project management

Familiarity with project management tools, particularly Azure DevOps
, as well as others like Jira, Trello, or similar task boards
Strong organizational and communication skills with a detail-oriented mindset
Proficient in English (spoken and written) / Very Strong Communication
(American accent is a plus)
Comfortable working full-time on a night shift schedule
Able to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced setting
Knowledge of Agile or Scrum frameworks

Background supporting US-based clients or distributed teams
High Ownership; Cross-functional Technical Fluency; Experience Risk Management Practices and Operating in Fast-Paced Environments

Nice-to-Have:

Previous experience working on a night shift and remote setup
Has experience coordinating and delivering key cross-functional business initiatives at a high-level of impact and ownership
Scrum Master or PMP-related certification/training

jobs.title: BESS Project Manager
jobs.description:
This is a fully remote position with around 20% travel expectations.

About Ampirical

At Ampirical, we're shaping the future of the power grid with precision, innovation, and purpose. Just as the ampere is the foundation of electric current, Ampirical is a core force driving the energy sector forward. We focus on quality, forward-thinking solutions, and empowering our team to grow and thrive.

We don’t just build projects - we build careers. If you’re looking for a place where your contributions matter and your professional development is supported every step of the way, we’d love to meet you. Watch this video to get a glimpse into our culture.

Why Ampirical?

💰 Salary Range
: $100,000 - $165,000 (dependent on experience, education, and qualifications)

📈 Profit Sharing Bonus

🩺 Day-One Benefits
: Medical, Dental, Vision

💼 401(k)
with 4% match and immediate vesting

🏖️ PTO
: 120+ hours of PTO + 10 paid holidays

🗓️ Flexible Work Schedule
: Every other Friday off

📚 Career Development
: Advancement opportunities, tuition reimbursement

🧘 Perks
: Gym membership stipend, wellness program, fertility benefits, pet insurance, and more

Your Role: BESS Project Manager

As a Project Manager at Ampirical, you’ll manage high-stakes, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects with a focus on excellence. You'll lead multi-discipline engineering projects, ensuring timely, on-budget completion while upholding our Quality Assurance (QA)/Quality Control (QC) guidelines. Working with talented engineers, sub-contractors, and clients, you’ll be at the forefront of designing and delivering innovative power solutions.

You’ll play a crucial role in shaping the power grid’s future while enjoying a rewarding career with ample opportunities for growth. At Ampirical, we believe that challenging work should also be fulfilling, and we empower our team with the resources and support needed to succeed.

What You’ll Do

Managing the full project life cycle, including safety, scope, schedule, budget, and risk for complex BESS projects
Overseeing project designs, Bill of Materials (BOM), equipment specifications, and construction requirements
Collaborating with internal teams, subcontractors, and clients to drive project milestones
Leading the development of project proposals, schedules, and material lists
Providing project performance updates to internal and external stakeholders
Ensuring high-quality deliverables by conducting engineering work reviews
Traveling to client sites and vendor facilities to ensure alignment on project goals

What You Bring

🎓 Education
: Bachelor’s Degree
in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field (preferred)

📊 Experience And Skills

Experience managing BESS projects in the utility industry (or similar industry experience)
Expertise in cost/schedule reporting
A strong leader with advanced organizational skills to manage multiple complex projects
A skilled communicator capable of leading cross-functional teams and engaging stakeholders

jobs.title: Project Manager - Commercial
jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Are you passionate about innovation, delivering customer value, and building long-term strategic relationships? Do you enjoy solving complex challenges at scale?

Veeva Systems is seeking experienced and motivated Project Managers to join our Commercial Services team. In this role, you will lead the implementation and ongoing optimization of Veeva Vault Commercial solutions for some of the world’s largest and most impactful life sciences organizations.

This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. There is no work location requirement. It is customer-facing, with occasional travel requirements up to 15% of the time.

Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT) for this employment position.

What You'll Do

Lead the end-to-end delivery of Veeva’s Commercial solutions, from project initiation through successful go-live and continuous improvement phases
Serve as the primary liaison between Veeva and customer stakeholders, ensuring alignment across business, quality, and IT teams
Facilitate delivery and execution of strategic roadmaps, managing multiple workstreams and dependencies
Guide customers in adopting industry and Veeva best practices, with a focus on long-term value realization and process optimization
Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks and issues, and ensure projects stay on schedule and within scope
Define success metrics and consistently report on project performance and customer outcomes
Foster strong, trusted relationships with customer teams, acting as a partner in their digital quality transformation journey

Requirements

8+ years of experience in software implementation, with a strong background in project management and customer-facing delivery
Demonstrated success leading technology implementations or managing IT operations in a consultancy or enterprise environment
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business needs into actionable project plans
Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
Familiarity with content or data management platforms

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program

Compensation

Base pay: $80,000 - $200,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

jobs.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™

ASRC NetCentric is seeking a Project
Manager
to support a DHS program.

Work location:
Remote

Clearance
: Public Trust

Summary:
The DHS Program will provide professional services to support application analysis, architectural design, engineering, development, maintenance, and support. Work includes implementation of Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, Power Platform (PowerApps, Power Automate, Flow, and Power Business Intelligent (BI)), SharePoint, Office 365, Azure products and Services, Dataverse, Drupal, Confluence, Jira, and ServiceNow. We will provide a team experienced with design, agile software development, project management, technical architecture, engineering and design, continuous integration and delivery, integration, testing, configuration management, ongoing operations and maintenance, and cloud migration.

The Project Manager will own cost/schedule/quality for assigned projects; supervise technical staff; enforce standards; integrate Agile practices with PMBOK and DHS SELC.

Responsibilities

Management and technical direction of projects
Project performance including cost, schedule, deliverables, and contractual compliance, and is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of all project deliverable items
Overall project/task performance
Enforcing work standards, task schedules, reviewing work discrepancies, supervising technical
personnel, recommending project hires and terminations, and communicating policies, purposes, and goals of the organization to subordinate personnel
Assisting in the budgeting of required resources for successful project implementation and completion.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree, with 24 credit hours in business related courses.
5 years of experience combined in information systems development and project management from inception to deployment; demonstrated ability to manage a team.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
US Citizen and ability to successfully complete a government issued background investigation.
Ability to obtain a Public Trust. Prior Public Trust or Security Clearance, preferred
Possess superior verbal and written communication skills; able to clearly convey complex technical and programmatic topics to diverse stakeholders.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Exceptional organizational skills with consistent attention to detail and follow-through.
Demonstrated adaptability, with the ability to adjust quickly to shifting priorities, new technologies, or changes in project scope.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities; able to turn ambiguous requirements into actionable plans.
Ability to motivate and guide technical teams, promoting collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Drive the overall strategy for the client’s website and MarTech efforts

Lead client meetings around positioning, digital needs, project status, and integrated digital marketing plans
Attain a very high client satisfaction rating throughout the engagement

Experience with Google Analytics

Experience conducting usability testing
Hands-on experience with information architecture

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager - East Coast Hours
jobs.description:
About Our Client:

The organization is a global professional services firm with over 22,000 employees across more than 60 countries. It serves clients in real estate, infrastructure, energy, and natural resources sectors, focusing on delivering impactful projects and programs that improve people’s lives. The organization offers expertise in program, project, cost, asset, and commercial management, as well as controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero initiatives, and digital solutions. It is majority-owned by a leading commercial real estate services and investment firm, with a strategic partnership that enhances its program, project, and cost management capabilities worldwide.

About the Opportunity:

The ASSOCIATE PROJECT MANAGER role provides advanced administrative support to project management teams overseeing construction projects, primarily supporting projects in the Eastern Time Zone with a remote work schedule. This position is responsible for assisting in managing all aspects of project management, including budgeting, scheduling, procurement, quality, and risk, thereby contributing to the successful delivery of commercial real estate projects from planning through closeout.

Responsibilities:

Support project management teams in managing budgets, schedules, procurement, quality, and risk for commercial real estate projects.
Perform administrative tasks such as data entry, maintaining spreadsheets, managing purchase orders and invoicing, vendor management, and reporting.
Implement and maintain project documentation governance to ensure data accuracy, timeliness, and coordination according to organizational and client requirements.
Track project progress against goals, budgets, and timelines; report status and variances; develop action plans to meet objectives.
Lead smaller projects and third-party project delivery teams when assigned, including tracking performance and motivating team members.
Apply standard principles and procedures to complete tasks and address routine problems.
Demonstrate knowledge across several job areas within the function.
Model organizational values and communicate complex information clearly.
Maintain quality of own work and positively impact team performance.
Operate primarily within standardized procedures to meet objectives and deadlines.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

Authorization to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.
Bachelor's degree preferred; 2-5 years of relevant experience. Equivalent combinations of education and experience considered.
Preferred experience in architecture, engineering, or construction, including construction project management, owner's representation, or project management for commercial projects.
Ability to read and understand architectural drawings; knowledge of leases, contracts, and construction practices preferred.
Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and required experience with Kahua software.
Ability to analyze and solve moderately complex problems using technical judgment and precedent.
Strong interpersonal skills and an inquisitive approach.

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

The base salary range for this role is $70,000 to $90,000 USD, with final compensation based on experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity.
Eligibility for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:

RemoteHunter is a recruitment partner of this role. Please note that all employment decisions, including candidate assessment, interviews, hiring, compensation, and employment terms, are made exclusively by the hiring employer.

jobs.description:
Overview

Do you want to build an impactful career to change the world for the better?

Geosyntec has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Environmental Remediation Project Manager – Geologist or Engineer
to join our Portland, Oregon office. This role is well-suited for a geologist, hydrogeologist, or engineer with consulting experience in the Pacific Northwest who has successfully led environmental investigation and remediation projects. In this position, your project leadership, client service, and technical expertise will be central to guiding complex contaminated site assessment and remediation work, including remedial investigations and feasibility studies, groundwater monitoring, soil vapor extraction, sediment and surface water sampling, technical reporting, and data-driven project delivery.

Geosyntec is an innovative, international engineering and consulting firm serving private and public-sector clients to address new ventures and complex problems involving our environment, natural resources, and civil infrastructure. Our engineers, scientists, technical and project employees serve our clients from offices across the world. Ranked by ENR as one of the top environmental engineering design firms, Geosyntec is internationally known for its technical leadership, broad experience, and exceptional client service.

We invest in our people. Each employee is unique, and your career at Geosyntec will be too. We offer competitive pay and benefits, and well-being programs to support you and your family.

To Learn More Visit: http://www.geosyntec.com/careers/ .

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

This opportunity is especially well-suited for someone who enjoys combining field-based technical insight with project coordination, data evaluation, client service, and high-quality deliverables. You will have the opportunity to move beyond task execution into broader project ownership while continuing to contribute meaningfully to technical strategy and field implementation.

Task and project management, including planning and implementing investigation and remediation projects, budgeting and budget management, adherence to schedule, quality, client satisfaction, and profitability.
Evaluate contaminated sites and develop investigation and remediation approaches, including remedial investigations/feasibility studies, removal action work plans, remediation design plans, and remedy implementation under state and federal cleanup programs.
Lead proposal and work plan development, environmental data evaluation, conceptual site model updates, cost-benefit analyses, and technical recommendations that support practical cleanup strategies.
Implement and manage remedial pilot tests and systems, including soil vapor extraction, groundwater monitoring programs, vendor selection, logistical coordination, permitting, and supervision of field teams.
Write technical reports, letters, memoranda, plans, specifications, and proposals; oversee and review documents prepared by project teams.
Build and maintain strong relationships with both new and existing clients, using your expertise to support Geosyntec’s growth through effective business development and client management.
Foster trust-based relationships with clients, regulatory personnel, and other project stakeholders.
Mentor, guide, and motivate early career staff assigned in the areas of project performance, including technical tasks listed above, client expectations, and career development; work with employees to correct deficiencies.
At times, this position may also include fieldwork such as site visits, groundwater monitoring, surface and subsurface sediment sampling, surface water sampling, drilling oversight, contractor oversight, and remediation system operations, maintenance, and construction.
Drive personal, company, and rental vehicles to client or company project or office sites, and other business locations, as needed.

Education and Licensure

Bachelor’s degree in geology, hydrogeology, engineering, environmental science, or a closely related discipline. (required)
Advanced degree in geology, hydrogeology, engineering, environmental science, or a related discipline. (preferred)
Professional registration (i.e., P.E. P.G.). (preferred)

Skills, Experience And Qualifications

About SAMY

We weren't built to follow, we were built to lead.

SAMY is the global powerhouse redefining brand communication for a social-first world—helping brands stay relevant, shape culture, and build real connections at the speed the world moves. Since 2013, we've grown from a bold idea into a global force: 1,200+ experts, 17+ offices, 55 markets, 22+ countries. We are Path Finders: curious, ambitious, and never afraid to challenge what's next.

We don't play it safe. We build what's next.

Instagram | TikTok | Culture page

Role Mission

As Project Manager SaaS Implementation, reporting to the Global Implementation Director, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of complex Sprinklr implementation projects for US enterprise clients, coordinating cross-functional teams and client stakeholders, acting as the primary client liaison, and serving as the operational backbone of the practice to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery that maximizes client value and satisfaction.

,

Key Responsibilities

Manage end-to-end delivery of Sprinklr implementation projects, creating and executing detailed project plans aligned with client business objectives.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, including technical consultants, solution architects, implementation managers, and client stakeholders.
Serve as primary client liaison, leading steering committees and executive briefings, and communicating project status, risks, and mitigation strategies.

Proven experience managing enterprise SaaS implementation projects end to end, with solid understanding of technical delivery processes (Sprinklr or similar CXM/social platforms is a plus).

Excellent communication skills with both technical teams and executive audiences, including advanced/fluent English to work with US clients.

Benefits

The SAMY Mindset

Forget the job description for a second. The real question is: are you a Path Finder? Bold enough to challenge what's possible. Collaborative enough to build it together. Driven enough to make it happen.

Be Kind

Go Beyond
— because good is never enough when excellence is the standard.

Craft Together
— because the best ideas don't happen in silos.

Enjoy the Journey
— because growth lives outside the comfort zone.

Own It

At SAMY, difference is not something we accommodate, it's what makes us stronger.

jobs.description:
Overview

Do you want to build an impactful career to change the world for the better?

Geosyntec has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Environmental Remediation Project Manager – Geologist or Engineer
to join our Seattle, Washington office. This role is well-suited for a geologist, hydrogeologist, or engineer with consulting experience in the Pacific Northwest who has successfully led environmental investigation and remediation projects. In this position, your project leadership, client service, and technical expertise will be central to guiding complex contaminated site assessment and remediation work, including remedial investigations and feasibility studies, groundwater monitoring, soil vapor extraction, sediment and surface water sampling, technical reporting, and data-driven project delivery.

Geosyntec is an innovative, international engineering and consulting firm serving private and public-sector clients to address new ventures and complex problems involving our environment, natural resources, and civil infrastructure. Our engineers, scientists, technical and project employees serve our clients from offices across the world. Ranked by ENR as one of the top environmental engineering design firms, Geosyntec is internationally known for its technical leadership, broad experience, and exceptional client service.

We invest in our people. Each employee is unique, and your career at Geosyntec will be too. We offer competitive pay and benefits, and well-being programs to support you and your family.

To Learn More Visit: http://www.geosyntec.com/careers/ .

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

This opportunity is especially well-suited for someone who enjoys combining field-based technical insight with project coordination, data evaluation, client service, and high-quality deliverables. You will have the opportunity to move beyond task execution into broader project ownership while continuing to contribute meaningfully to technical strategy and field implementation.

Task and project management, including planning and implementing investigation and remediation projects, budgeting and budget management, adherence to schedule, quality, client satisfaction, and profitability.
Evaluate contaminated sites and develop investigation and remediation approaches, including remedial investigations/feasibility studies, removal action work plans, remediation design plans, and remedy implementation under state and federal cleanup programs.
Lead proposal and work plan development, environmental data evaluation, conceptual site model updates, cost-benefit analyses, and technical recommendations that support practical cleanup strategies.
Implement and manage remedial pilot tests and systems, including soil vapor extraction, groundwater monitoring programs, vendor selection, logistical coordination, permitting, and supervision of field teams.
Write technical reports, letters, memoranda, plans, specifications, and proposals; oversee and review documents prepared by project teams.
Build and maintain strong relationships with both new and existing clients, using your expertise to support Geosyntec’s growth through effective business development and client management.
Foster trust-based relationships with clients, regulatory personnel, and other project stakeholders.
Mentor, guide, and motivate early career staff assigned in the areas of project performance, including technical tasks listed above, client expectations, and career development; work with employees to correct deficiencies.
At times, this position may also include fieldwork such as site visits, groundwater monitoring, surface and subsurface sediment sampling, surface water sampling, drilling oversight, contractor oversight, and remediation system operations, maintenance, and construction.
Drive personal, company, and rental vehicles to client or company project or office sites, and other business locations, as needed.

Education and Licensure

Bachelor’s degree in geology, hydrogeology, engineering, environmental science, or a closely related discipline. (required)
Advanced degree in geology, hydrogeology, engineering, environmental science, or a related discipline. (preferred)
Professional registration (i.e., P.E. P.G.). (preferred)

Skills, Experience And Qualifications

At least 7 years (8+ years preferred) of direct environmental consulting experience in the Pacific Northwest marketplace; or equivalent combination of education and experience. (required)
Strong understanding of Pacific Northwest state and federal environmental regulations, with the ability to apply regulatory requirements to investigation, remediation, and closure strategies. (required)
Experience coordinating projects and tasks, including scope, schedule, budget, resource allocation, quality, technical oversight, subcontractor coordination, and financial tracking. (required)
Experience with remedial investigations, feasibility studies, groundwater monitoring, multi-media sampling methods and data acquisition, and environmental data analysis. (required)
Strong technical writing skills, including experience preparing work plans, RI/FS documents, monitoring reports, technical memoranda, proposals, and client-ready deliverables. (required)
Ability to mentor and coordinate early-career staff and field teams while maintaining strong communication with clients, regulators, subcontractors, and internal project teams. (required)
Ability to succeed in a fast-paced consulting environment, handling multiple project assignments, meeting strict deadlines, and traveling to client facilities as needed. (required)
Excellent writing and communication skills. (required)
Field work and overnight travel may be required.
Current OSHA 40-hr HAZWOPER training and refreshers. (preferred)
Health & Safety training and medical monitoring. (required)
Client-driven drug and background testing may be required.
Valid U.S. driver’s license and a satisfactory driving record for business travel. (required)

Build the delivery methodology and implementation playbook. jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, OMHS Software, Controls, and Science
jobs.description:
Description

This isn't a program management role where someone else defines the problem and you track tickets to completion. You will own delivery of programs where the strategic goal is clear but the technical path forward is not. You will be the person who turns ambiguity into milestones, dependencies into action plans, and cross-team confusion into coordinated delivery.

We're deploying new automation technology to fulfillment sites quarterly. Each deployment involves software teams, controls engineers, hardware commissioning, field operations, and vendor coordination converging on a building with a ship date that does not move. Someone needs to make sure all of those pieces come together. That someone is you.

In our operating model, TPMs are assigned to programs with cross-team dependencies, not to individual products. Product managers own the what and why. Engineering leaders run their own sprints. You step in when delivery requires coordination across team boundaries, and you manage multiple programs simultaneously scoped to quarterly milestones.

You will work independently, partnering with product managers and engineering leads to scope work, establish milestones, and drive delivery. Your programs will have defined strategic goals but may not yet have clear technical solutions, and you will drive the clarity needed to move forward.

Impact at scale: The programs you manage will directly affect whether Amazon's next fulfillment buildings launch on time with functioning automation. The coordination frameworks you help establish will become the foundation for how we scale deployments from a handful of sites to dozens. Your work will be visible in buildings that are running, shipping packages, and operating reliably.

Key job responsibilities

Program Delivery Across Team Boundaries

Own planning, execution, and delivery of programs spanning multiple engineering teams and deployment organizations
Partner with product managers and engineering managers to scope work, set priorities, and establish quarterly milestones
Manage cross-team dependencies, ensuring changes in one system do not break upstream or downstream systems
Coordinate deployment activities including testing, rollout, and operational readiness for live fulfillment sites

Drive Execution Through Complexity

Establish program requirements, success metrics, and delivery timelines for programs with unclear technical solutions
Manage overall schedule, proactively mitigate risks, and keep scope under control
Drive crisp and timely decisions, clear blockers, and escalate appropriately when programs are at risk
Plan for the unexpected and ensure system maintainability is not compromised by delivery pressure

Communicate with Clarity and Purpose

Own program communications so stakeholders always have the right information at the right time
Produce clear documentation: program requirements, risk logs, milestone tracking, and stakeholder updates
Facilitate discussions that balance business urgency with technical rigor
Present program status and trade-off decisions to senior leadership

Build Better Delivery Practices

Identify opportunities to improve how cross-team programs are planned and executed
Incorporate system quality and operational excellence improvements into program plans
Run retrospectives and post-mortems that capture real learnings and drive change
Mentor peers and contribute to hiring across the team

A day in the life

Your morning starts checking in on the two programs you currently own: one is a multi-team software integration with a deployment date next quarter, the other is a hardware-software coordination effort where you're tracking vendor deliveries against commissioning windows. Mid-morning, you're running a dependency sync between two engineering teams whose changes are converging on the same system. After lunch, you're updating your risk log after discovering a potential timeline conflict and drafting an escalation path. You end your day preparing a milestone update for your stakeholder review, clearly showing what's green, what's at risk, and what help you need. Your customers are the engineering leads, product managers, and operations teams who rely on your coordination to deliver.

About The Team

We are a division within Amazon Fulfillment Technology and Robotics focused on standardizing the equipment and systems that make up our first, middle, and last mile facilities. We are a passionate group of innovators, engineers, and business leaders dedicated to reducing the variability and complacency in our current logistics systems. Our team thrives on collaboration, continuous learning, and the shared vision of developing technologies to bring innovation and scalability back to our automation equipment.

Amazon installs a significant quantity of new buildings every year. The historical model allowed each integrator to use their own equipment, controls, subsystems, and methodologies. While that enabled Amazon to succeed to this point, the variability between buildings has proven difficult to support and scale. Our charge is to build partnerships focused on consistency and scalability across the network of the future, partnering with key suppliers to help them scale manufacturing capabilities and refining designs to drive innovation, operational uptime, and better meet the specific needs of Amazon's operational environment.

Our software organization delivers the platforms, controls architecture, and AI/CV capabilities that enable Amazon to own its industrial automation ecosystem end-to-end. The product ecosystem spans machine-level controls, unified SCADA visualization, computer vision, and AI-driven design tooling, all built on a shared telemetry foundation and deployed to fulfillment sites globally.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Summary

We are currently seeking a Program Manager
. This position is a full-time opportunity located on-site at Tyndall Air Force Base, near Panama City, FL.

The Program Manager will provide project management support to government programs focused on Research, Development, Test and Evaluation (RDT&E) efforts in Civil Engineer Robotic and Autonomous Systems Technologies (CERAST) in support of the U.S. Air Force Civil Engineer Center. This role sits within the Defense and Material Solutions (DMS) Business Line, National Security Business Unit, Advanced Materials and Energetics (AME) Division.

The selected candidate will build, shape, and lead the CERAST Program — directing day-to-day execution while managing cost, schedule, and technical performance. Active research areas include unmanned/autonomous systems, robotics, sensor/payload integration, rapid damage assessment, cybersecurity, RF communications, and artificial intelligence.

Responsibilities

As a Program Manager, the selected individual will lead a multidisciplinary research program supporting national security RDT&E objectives. Responsibilities may include:

Lead program teams with ultimate responsibility for meeting cost, schedule, quality, and technical/contractual performance of the CERAST program
Build upon current programs to secure new projects, guide internal investment strategy, orchestrate market engagements, and grow the program into larger markets
Manage client expectations and leverage client relationships to develop additional business opportunities
Work closely with engineering leads to ensure high-quality, mission-relevant deliverables and with Division Managers to drive execution and innovation
Establish and maintain scope, budget, and schedule baselines; report performance against those baselines and manage approved changes
Apply processes and procedures to identify, analyze, classify, prioritize, and manage program risks; formulate a risk management plan that assigns responsibility and specifies mitigation approaches and contingencies
Establish project performance metrics that ensure successful program completion
Prepare and deliver program reports and contract deliverables, including monthly status reports, financial expenditure reports, program management reviews, weekly leadership updates, and biweekly SITREPs
Integrate safety policies and regulations into the project plan, including early identification and elimination of hazards, development of program safety measures, and implementation of standard workplace safety practices
Support Battelle pipeline growth through coordination of multi-disciplinary project and proposal teams across multiple business lines and supporting teammates

Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience
Experience leading engineering and Research and Development programs
Experience planning and tracking projects using program management software
Experience preparing research proposals, research plans, and test plans; writing technical papers; executing RDT&E activities; and leading professional teams responsible for multiple concurrent RDT&E efforts
Experience mitigating risks through proactive management and remediation of personnel, program, client, and security issues, including tracking trends and communicating KPIs

Experience with unmanned systems, autonomous systems, and sensor/payload integration

In our business, delivery is the product—and world-class hardware performance must be matched by flawless operational execution, financial handoff accuracy, and strict technical change control.
Position Overview

We are seeking a high-execution, technically grounded Implementation & Technical Operations Project Manager
to own order delivery, operational handoffs, infrastructure change workflows, and billing enablement.
In addition to leading customer implementations and verifying exact delivery dates for Finance, you will serve as the operational backbone for technical change management—coordinating complex cluster upgrades, network maintenance, server inventory tracking, and cross-functional support projects alongside our NOC and Engineering teams.
Core Responsibilities

1. Order Delivery, Delivery Verification & Finance Handoff

Sales-to-Ops Handoff:
Own the post-sale handoff, verifying technical order requirements (custom hardware builds, networking setups, IP allocations) immediately upon contract execution.
Vendor & Logistics Coordination:
Partner with third-party data center operators, hardware suppliers, and internal engineering to orchestrate provisioning schedules, shipping logistics, and hot-swap/cold-spare staging.
Delivery Confirmation & Acceptance:
Formally verify and document when services are fully provisioned, tested, and turned over to the client (verifying exact Service Commencement Dates).
Finance & Billing Alignment:
Provide formal delivery sign-off documentation to Finance to trigger accurate billing cycles, ensure zero revenue leakage, and seamlessly tie operational completion to invoice activation.

2. Support Project Management & Technical Execution

Support PM:
Act as the project lead for complex, multi-stage customer support requests, custom environment modifications, and escalated technical remediations.
Cluster Upgrades & Maintenance:
Coordinate end-to-end planning and delivery for live cluster upgrades, GPU scale-outs, firmware updates, and scheduled hardware refreshes.
Network & Infrastructure Changes:
Manage logistics, communication, and execution schedules for network topology shifts, rack re-cabling, and IP transit updates.

3. Change Management & Governance

Change Control Board (CAB):
Establish and oversee formal Change Management protocols for all production maintenance, system upgrades, and network changes to protect customer SLAs.
Maintenance Windows & Notifications:
Schedule maintenance windows, align engineering resources, and draft clear, professional technical advisories for impacted clients.

4. Asset & Inventory Tracking

Inventory Management:
Maintain real-time tracking of data center hardware assets, chassis inventory, spare drive pools, switches, cabling, and hot-swap/cold-spare components across all facility locations.
Supply Chain Planning:
Monitor buffer stock levels to ensure rapid replacement turnaround and prevent provisioning bottlenecks.

The Project Manager is accountable for project scope, plans, schedules, resource coordination, delivery risks and agreed outcomes. The position assembles multidisciplinary teams, assigns responsibilities and makes project delivery decisions within the CIC mandate, approved resources and the UBC AWS collaboration agreement. It directly supervises project assistants and leads the project work of developers, consultants, senior solutions architects and student staff. As a member of the CIC management team, the Project Manager contributes to strategic and operational planning and establishes and improves project management practices that support reliable delivery, effective partnerships and student development.

Organizational Status

The position reports to the Director and works closely with UBC and AWS CIC colleagues, senior project sponsors, technical specialists, the Office of the Provost and Vice President, Academic, Faculties, UBC IT and other academic and administrative units. The role provides project leadership across participating organizations and represents the CIC in matters concerning assigned project delivery.

Work Performed

Specific Duties:

Leads concurrent small and medium scale cloud innovation projects, including complex AI initiatives, from challenge scoping, planning and team formation through development, testing, demonstrations and project closure.
Works with sponsors, technical leads and subject matter experts to define requirements, success criteria, scope, constraints and deliverables; documents and maintains agreement on project objectives.
Develops and maintains project plans, schedules, milestones and resource requirements; assembles teams, assigns responsibilities and balances competing demands across assigned projects.
Evaluates changes to scope, schedules and resources, resolves dependencies and determines corrective action. Makes significant delivery decisions within approved parameters and escalates decisions requiring additional authority or resources to the Director.
Tracks progress, risks and issues, anticipates delays and addresses barriers to delivery. Leads sponsor reviews of project outcomes and coordinates completion of agreed deliverables and project closure.
Provides project direction to developers, designers, senior solutions architects and other specialists delivering serverless web applications, AI enabled tools and cloud solutions using AWS, infrastructure as code and related technologies.
Works with technical leads to translate architectural recommendations and development constraints into delivery plans; manages interdependencies among data preparation, AI integration, application development, testing and release activities.
Establishes project quality and validation objectives with sponsors and technical specialists. Ensures required architecture, security, development and compliance reviews are incorporated into project work and identified issues are addressed with the responsible specialists.
Manages requirements validation, testing and pilot activities; coordinates demonstrations, technical and user documentation, and handover of prototypes and supporting materials to sponsors.
Owns relationships with senior internal and external project stakeholders for assigned projects, clarifies commitments, negotiates feasible delivery expectations and resolves issues affecting scope, timing and outcomes.
Leads project meetings, sponsor discussions and progress presentations; explains technical considerations, dependencies, risks and options in terms that support informed decisions by technical and non-technical audiences.
Works with technical and communications colleagues to prepare project summaries, web content and other approved communications; coordinates sharing of project outcomes and open source materials in accordance with CIC practices.
Selects, adapts and establishes CIC project management methods, procedures, documentation and quality objectives within applicable UBC requirements and the agreed UBC AWS innovation approach.
Evaluates delivery results, lessons learned and student feedback; implements improvements to project practices, team coordination and the work integrated learning experience.
Contributes to CIC strategic and operational planning by advising on project capacity, delivery priorities, risks and improvement opportunities. Maintains appropriate professional designations and current knowledge of project management approaches and relevant cloud and AI technologies.
Mentors student and junior staff, identifies learning needs and ensures access to suitable tools, training and guidance. Balances learning opportunities with project requirements and delivery commitments.
Addresses performance concerns within supervisory authority and works with the relevant supervisor, the Director and Human Resources on matters requiring formal action.

Core Duties:

Initiates projects following appropriate project management methodology including gathering and defining project requirements, developing project charters, project plans, budgets and schedules, identifying staffing requirements, and forming project teams.
Selects and follows project management methods, procedures, and quality objectives, and tracks metrics for assessing progress.
Balances workload, provides technical and analytical guidance and work direction to project team, including scheduling, assignment of work, review of project efforts and removal of roadblocks which may inhibit project success.
Ensures that all team members have the tools and training required to perform effectively, and provides the team with constructive feedback as it pertains to project performance.
Assesses variances from the project plans, budgets and schedules, develops and implements changes as necessary to ensure that the project remains within specified scope and is within time, cost, and quality objectives, and keeps management aware of the situation.
Conducts formal review with business sponsor at project completion to confirm acceptance and satisfaction.
Identifies potential areas for improvement in current methodologies and provides guidance to other less experienced project managers.
Develops and maintains a productive working relationship with project sponsors, vendors and key clients.
Maintains appropriate professional designations and up to date knowledge of current information technology techniques and tools.
Performs other related duties as required.

Consequence of Error/Judgement

The position exercises professional judgment and works with wide latitude in decisions affecting scope, resources, schedules, quality and stakeholder commitments. These decisions influence project feasibility, CIC resources, delivery outcomes and student learning. Inadequate scoping, coordination or risk management can cause rework, additional costs, missed commitments, unusable deliverables or compliance concerns. Mishandling sensitive information can have legal and reputational consequences and undermine confidence in UBC, AWS and the CIC. The Project Manager anticipates problems, evaluates options and takes corrective action or escalates matters beyond delegated authority.

Supervision Received

Reports to the Director and receives broad direction on priorities and intended outcomes. Works with wide latitude within the CIC mandate, collaboration commitments and approved resources. Work is reviewed against broad project objectives, delivery quality and team leadership. Consults the Director on material changes or matters outside delegated authority, and works closely with technical experts and sponsors.

Supervision Given

Directly supervises project assistants and other assigned staff. Directs multidisciplinary project teams, including senior technical specialists and students, and coordinates work through designated team leads and relevant supervisors. Provides coaching, mentorship and performance feedback.

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. In-depth knowledge of applications and the business requirements supporting them. Minimum of five years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion

Preferred Qualifications

Progressive project and/or technology management experience (or an equivalent combination of education and experience). Experience in a university, higher education, or other public sector environment is highly preferred.
Proven track record operating in a project manager role specifically managing, designing, developing, and implementing IT systems or processes.
Experience with technology projects, software development, technical support, and the implementation of medium scale, complex, or enterprise level systems.
Experience in change management, budget development, financial management, and risk management.
Managerial experience (or equivalent combination of education and experience) with the ability to mentor and coach staff, act as a resource, and maintain high motivation.
Understanding of key trends and players in the IT industry particularly regarding mobile applications and digital media, alongside knowledge of IT application development methodologies, best practices, benchmarks, and "rules of thumb."
A Project Management Professional (PMP) designation is an asset.
Effective leadership, consulting, consensus building, conflict resolution, negotiation, and team building skills.
Ability to effectively facilitate groups to achieve appropriate outcomes, as well as develop and deliver effective presentations and workshops.
Ability to develop and maintain cooperative and productive working relationships with current and potential customers.
Ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and priorities while working in a fast paced environment.
Knowledge and experience with project management methodology and structure are important but the role will require being flexible, and not dogmatic.
Emotional intelligence and elevated relationship management skills are import

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

As the Project Manager, you are responsible for planning, implementing, tracking, and reporting of assigned projects which have a beginning, an end, and specified deliverables. You will manage project risks, issues/problems, and activity progress to ensure project goals are achieved, and assist with problem resolution or risk mitigation as needed. The Project Manager identifies resources needed, assign major project roles and coordinate activities and tasks among project team members, other internal departments and client or vendor/subcontractor organizations as needed to meet project goals and ensure project completion is on schedule, within budget constraints, and of the appropriate quality standards for the project scope. As a representative of the Bank, you are required to present a positive and professional image at all times.

Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer science, Management Information Systems, Business Administration or other related discipline required; or the equivalent combination of education and experience that is required for the specific job level is required
Strong technical background to manage technical projects and handle competing interests required
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or the equivalent level of education and experience for the job level is preferred

COMPETENCIES

Possess knowledge of project management standards, processes, procedures and guidelines
Possess knowledge of the industry project management best practices, such as the Project Management Body of Knowledge
Possess knowledge of various types of IT project methodologies and life cycles (for example, conversions, incremental, rapid delivery, classic or traditional waterfall phases of analysis, design, development, testing and implementation) and the correct project application
Possess knowledge of standards relevant to the software industry (for example, ISO, CMM and Six Sigma)
Ability to adhere to the approved Project Management policy and procedures
Possess knowledge of financial services industry
Possess advanced skill in use of Project Management software to manage projects (such as MS Project and auxiliary tools like earned value database, audit tools, project repository, including risk, issues and action items database, SLIM Estimate, Metrics and Control)
Possess skill in the use of negotiation techniques to reach agreement when there are widely differing viewpoints
Demonstrated skill in managing project budgets and timelines
Possess excellent analysis, problem-solving, team, conflict management and time management skills
Possess excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to interact effectively with executive and senior management
Ability to set clear expectations, manage team performance and build high morale among team members
Ability to maintain confidentiality and carry out assignments that are sensitive in nature
Ability to analyze contracts and invoices in order to give budget cost and spend recommendations.

Duties And Responsibilities

Responsible for developing and communicating project management practices for the organization, preparing reporting for Executive Management and Technology Demand Management Team on the project pipeline and status of projects, and providing coaching to team members on project management disciplines
Manage project initiation activities that include identifying contractual obligations, bank needs and goals, existing situation, necessary contacts, and access to existing information as needed
Plan and coordinate all aspects of technical and non-technical projects from initiation through delivery
Focus on meeting project commitments, including communications with sponsors, stakeholders, team members, and external participants
Ensure requirements for internal projects align to operational standards and develop alternate requirements or document exceptions as appropriate
Develop, define and execute project plans, project scope, activities, schedules, budgets and deliverables
Identify needed resources for projects, and define and assign major project roles
Coordinate activities and tasks among project team members, other internal departments and client or vendor/subcontractor organizations as needed to meet project goals and ensure project completion is on schedule, within budget constraints, and of the appropriate quality standards for the project scope
Assign and monitor work of project team, providing technical and/or analytical support and direction, and interface with external clients or field-based employees on matters
Manage project risks, issues/problems, and activity progress to ensure project goals (for example, deadline, scope and quality) are achieved, and assist with problem resolution or risk mitigation as needed
May manage the integration of vendor/subcontractor tasks, and track and review vendor/subcontractor deliverables, if appropriate for the project
Serve as liaison between technical and non-technical teams, in internal organizations as well as in client and vendor/subcontractor organizations, to ensure all project targets and requirements are met
Deliver informational and decision-seeking presentations as required to Executive Management
Conduct project closure activities to formalize and communicate the project acceptance, handover documentation and ongoing activities to accountable teams and complete a post-implementation review to identify areas of improvement
Identify project management coordination process gaps or areas for improvement, recommends and implements solutions
Support budget planning by identifying cost savings and spend reductions
Maintain compliance with regulations and bank policies and procedures, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) requirements
Consistently support, uphold and model the organization’s core values and standards
Complete other duties as assigned as determined by management to be reasonable and beneficial

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate effectively with team members, departments, management, clients, and vendors/subcontractors, both individually and in front of a group. Regular use of the telephone and email for communication is essential. Remaining in a stationary position for extended periods of time is common. Must be able to accurately gather and process verbal and written information and properly prepare or inspect documents. Good manual dexterity is needed for the frequent use of common office equipment such as computer terminals, calculators, copiers and telephones. Occasional out-of-town or overnight travel may be required. Occasional travel to NETN branches may be required.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager/Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description
Position Summary: Ensure predictable, consistent, and successful project delivery. The Technical Project Manager will plan, coordinate, and monitor larger scale scope and budget projects with a high degree of complexity and risk. The Technical Project Manager will partner with key business stakeholders to ensure a successful start-up and completion of a project. Projects can span multiple business units or functional areas. The Technical Project Manager is expected to work under minimal supervision with oversight provided by the Project Delivery.

Primary Responsibilities:

· Ensure predictable, consistent, and successful project delivery

· Provide a holistic view of the overall project to the organization and all stakeholders

· Exhibit proactive behavior by engaging in project planning activities, including but not limited to:

o Defining the overall scope of the project

o Creating and maintaining a consolidated timeline/schedule highlighting the major milestones and associated dates for project activities

o Identifying and communicating project dependencies

o Putting a mechanism in place to ensure on-going control of the project (e.g., kick-off meeting, overall project management approach, communication plan, risk management, issues management, change controls, etc.)

· Define project governance, outlining roles, responsibilities, decision rights and clearly defined escalation path

· Ensure success criteria defined upfront to promote alignment and actively manage to expected project outcomes

· Keep all stakeholders (internal and external) engaged in the project, aligned on expected outcomes and informed about what is occurring throughout the project

· Proactively communicate the project’s progress on an ongoing basis, ensuring transparency throughout the project lifecycle. Provide leadership and key stakeholders with the information and venues to make effective, timely decisions

· Complete all the above in adherence to the Client Infrastructure Delivery Lifecycle (IDLC) framework

· Knowledgeable about how the organize works; knows how to get things done through formal channels and informal network. Understands the culture of organization.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent work experience

· 5 – 7 years of previous project management and/or relevant consulting experience

· Knowledge of, and demonstrated experience, in project management processes and methodologies as well as project lifecycles

· Experience in banking, financial services, and/or software industries preferred

· Experience in driving large scale change efforts

· Experience with matrix management of cross-functional processes and teams

· Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred

· Familiarity with project management tools

Possesses the following key skills/behaviors:

· Stakeholder Partnership:

o Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills, ability to develop and maintain strong working relationships and strategic partnerships with key stakeholders/customers across client to maximize project effectiveness and influence

o Poised and composed interaction with all levels of the organization (within Division), including senior-level audience

· Judgment:

o Ability to practically apply project management concepts to facilitate the achievement of business objectives ensuring predictable, consistent, and successful project delivery

o Ability to adapt to and work effectively within a variety of situations and with various individuals

· Team Leadership:

o Proven ability to quickly earn the trust of sponsors and key stakeholders, mobilize and motivate project team, set direction and approach, resolve conflict, deliver tough messages with grace

o Ability to lead and influence with minimal direction from sponsor or manager

· Accountability & Commitment:

o Ability to achieve project outcomes and stakeholder satisfaction

o Ability to identify project obstacles and proactively mitigate risks. Escalates and resolves complex issues effectively

· Learning Agility:

o Ability to quickly grasps complex concepts and conveys concepts in a way that is easily understood by others

o Ability to incorporate feedback and adjust plans or approach

· Business Acumen:

o Ability to provide a holistic view by coordinating with and monitoring all impacted business processes from initiation to delivery

o Ability to explain the business rationale and benefits of change to client, including impacts to project

· Problem Solving:

o Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems

o Ability to effectively and quickly solve complex problems rather than symptoms

· Process Adherence:

o Ability to engage in project initiating activities such as identifying stakeholders, identifying project management approach, defining roles and responsibilities, etc.

o Ability to use proven project management methods and practices to facilitate the achievement of project outcomes

o Ability to provide a complete view of the overall project to the organization and all stakeholders

Working Conditions:

· Environment – Office required (no hybrid)

· Physical Requirements – Sitting for long periods of time

Job Summary:

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery of services to clients, ensuring that all service level agreements (SLAs) are met and that client satisfaction is maintained at the highest level. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong leadership skills, capable of managing multiple accounts and fostering relationships with key stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in account delivery management and will be adept at navigating complex client environments. Manage client relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for all service-related inquiries and issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Familiarity with project management tools and software. Knowledge of ITIL or other service management frameworks. Strong negotiation skills and the ability to influence stakeholders. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications in service management or project management are a plus. Demonstrated ability to lead teams and manage client relationships effectively.

Job Description

Business Operations Manager

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

The Impact You’ll Make in This Role

As a Business Operations Manager, You Will Have The Opportunity To Tap Into Your Curiosity And Collaborate With Some Of The Most Innovative People Around The World. Here, You Will Make An Impact By

Drive strategic initiatives with enterprise impact

Lead and coordinate high-priority project workstreams connected to annual operating plan priorities and long-term growth objectives. You will help advance highly visible global programs, including Global Category Management at scale, the Global DSR Incentive Portal Channel AI tools, and other commercial capability and productivity initiatives that shape how 3M grows through the channel.

Help shape the future of 3M Partner Rewards

Play a key role in evolving 3M Partner Rewards into a stronger strategic growth platform. You will support enhancements that improve the distributor sales representative experience, increase adoption, strengthen operational effectiveness, and ensure the program continues to deliver measurable value for channel partners and 3M.

Turn insights into action

Use data to identify performance trends, risks, and growth opportunities. Translate insights into clear, practical recommendations that improve channel performance, commercial execution, and operational outcomes. You will build dashboards, scorecards, and executive-ready materials that help leaders make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions.

Advance commercial excellence across the business

Support the execution of critical commercial excellence initiatives, including joint business planning, cross-sell programs, churn analysis, and new product introduction launches with channel partners. You will help build the structure, rhythm, and accountability needed to drive consistent execution across businesses, regions, and markets.

Connect teams and accelerate global alignment

Partner with division teams, channel leaders, marketing, supply chain, sales operations, and other stakeholders to align business plans, demand signals, investment priorities, and execution activities. Your ability to connect the dots, bring teams together, and drive clarity will be essential to delivering business results.

Build Capabilities That Strengthen Channel Performance

You will help ensure training and capability-building programs launch effectively, stay on track, and deliver against performance objectives.

Lead through influence in a complex, global environment

Work across multiple businesses, functions, and geographies to solve problems, remove barriers, and maintain momentum on strategic priorities. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a matrixed environment, communicates with impact, collaborates effectively, and brings strong execution discipline to complex initiatives.

This is a global role requiring collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple time zones.

Demonstrated success leading projects with multiple stakeholders and interconnected workstreams
