new_jobs.description:
Overview

Do you want to build an impactful career to change the world for the better?

Geosyntec has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Environmental Remediation Project Manager – Geologist or Engineer
to join our Seattle, Washington office. This role is well-suited for a geologist, hydrogeologist, or engineer with consulting experience in the Pacific Northwest who has successfully led environmental investigation and remediation projects. In this position, your project leadership, client service, and technical expertise will be central to guiding complex contaminated site assessment and remediation work, including remedial investigations and feasibility studies, groundwater monitoring, soil vapor extraction, sediment and surface water sampling, technical reporting, and data-driven project delivery.

Geosyntec is an innovative, international engineering and consulting firm serving private and public-sector clients to address new ventures and complex problems involving our environment, natural resources, and civil infrastructure. Our engineers, scientists, technical and project employees serve our clients from offices across the world. Ranked by ENR as one of the top environmental engineering design firms, Geosyntec is internationally known for its technical leadership, broad experience, and exceptional client service.

We invest in our people. Each employee is unique, and your career at Geosyntec will be too. We offer competitive pay and benefits, and well-being programs to support you and your family.

To Learn More Visit: http://www.geosyntec.com/careers/ .

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

This opportunity is especially well-suited for someone who enjoys combining field-based technical insight with project coordination, data evaluation, client service, and high-quality deliverables. You will have the opportunity to move beyond task execution into broader project ownership while continuing to contribute meaningfully to technical strategy and field implementation.

Task and project management, including planning and implementing investigation and remediation projects, budgeting and budget management, adherence to schedule, quality, client satisfaction, and profitability.
Evaluate contaminated sites and develop investigation and remediation approaches, including remedial investigations/feasibility studies, removal action work plans, remediation design plans, and remedy implementation under state and federal cleanup programs.
Lead proposal and work plan development, environmental data evaluation, conceptual site model updates, cost-benefit analyses, and technical recommendations that support practical cleanup strategies.
Implement and manage remedial pilot tests and systems, including soil vapor extraction, groundwater monitoring programs, vendor selection, logistical coordination, permitting, and supervision of field teams.
Write technical reports, letters, memoranda, plans, specifications, and proposals; oversee and review documents prepared by project teams.
Build and maintain strong relationships with both new and existing clients, using your expertise to support Geosyntec’s growth through effective business development and client management.
Foster trust-based relationships with clients, regulatory personnel, and other project stakeholders.
Mentor, guide, and motivate early career staff assigned in the areas of project performance, including technical tasks listed above, client expectations, and career development; work with employees to correct deficiencies.
At times, this position may also include fieldwork such as site visits, groundwater monitoring, surface and subsurface sediment sampling, surface water sampling, drilling oversight, contractor oversight, and remediation system operations, maintenance, and construction.
Drive personal, company, and rental vehicles to client or company project or office sites, and other business locations, as needed.

Education and Licensure

Bachelor’s degree in geology, hydrogeology, engineering, environmental science, or a closely related discipline. (required)
Advanced degree in geology, hydrogeology, engineering, environmental science, or a related discipline. (preferred)
Professional registration (i.e., P.E. P.G.). (preferred)

Skills, Experience And Qualifications

At least 7 years (8+ years preferred) of direct environmental consulting experience in the Pacific Northwest marketplace; or equivalent combination of education and experience. (required)
Strong understanding of Pacific Northwest state and federal environmental regulations, with the ability to apply regulatory requirements to investigation, remediation, and closure strategies. (required)
Experience coordinating projects and tasks, including scope, schedule, budget, resource allocation, quality, technical oversight, subcontractor coordination, and financial tracking. (required)
Experience with remedial investigations, feasibility studies, groundwater monitoring, multi-media sampling methods and data acquisition, and environmental data analysis. (required)
Strong technical writing skills, including experience preparing work plans, RI/FS documents, monitoring reports, technical memoranda, proposals, and client-ready deliverables. (required)
Ability to mentor and coordinate early-career staff and field teams while maintaining strong communication with clients, regulators, subcontractors, and internal project teams. (required)
Ability to succeed in a fast-paced consulting environment, handling multiple project assignments, meeting strict deadlines, and traveling to client facilities as needed. (required)
Excellent writing and communication skills. (required)
Field work and overnight travel may be required.
Current OSHA 40-hr HAZWOPER training and refreshers. (preferred)
Health & Safety training and medical monitoring. (required)
Client-driven drug and background testing may be required.
Valid U.S. driver’s license and a satisfactory driving record for business travel. (required)

This opportunity will be posted for at least five days. Below are the potential compensation ranges that we in good faith believe are applicable for this role at the time of this posting and are only applicable for jobs to be performed in the specified location(s) below. The typical base salary range for this position is just one component of Geosyntec’s total compensation package for employees. Actual compensation will be determined based on education, experience, skill set and location.

Minimum Salary: $101,650/year / Maximum Salary: $180,745/year (Seattle)

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to all eligible employees including, 9 paid holidays, 2 floating holidays, a minimum of 8 sick days, and a minimum of 11 vacation days per year, in line with state or federal requirements. Employees (and their families) are offered medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, 401(k), a variety of leaves of absences and other benefits to eligible employees.

As a primary customer liaison, you will build long-term relationships and act as a customer advocate, guiding them in the adoption of industry best practices and providing value through agile delivery.

You'll leverage your existing background in Life Sciences software implementation and program/project management while innovating and developing novel approaches to project delivery. You’ll be responsible for empowering enterprise companies with best-of-breed cloud-based technology.

Lead a key enterprise customer in the IT Operations and implementation of Veeva Quality Cloud suite
Manage a multi-year, multi-phased global implementation program, overseeing all aspects of program and project management, including resource planning, team leadership, project tracking, and forecasting
Act as the primary customer liaison, managing all communication and relationships between the project team, customer, and internal stakeholders

Mentor project teams and junior consultants within the Quality Services organization

Why This Role, Why Now

OneTrack is a profitable, growth-stage AI company redefining warehouse and logistics technology. We’ve proven product-market fit, signed marquee enterprise accounts, and are now scaling deployments across dozens of sites. The gap between “sold” and “successful” is where this role lives—and it’s the single highest-leverage hire we can make right now. We need a leader who can build the delivery engine that turns every contract into a measurable client outcome, while standing up the methodology and playbook the team will run for years to come.

About The Role

As Senior Implementation Manager, you will own the client journey end-to-end - from contract signature through steady-state value realization. This is not a role where you hand off a deck and move on. You will quarterback cross-functional workstreams, drive real operational outcomes on warehouse floors, and be accountable for the results long after go-live.

The work is genuinely complex: multi-site rollouts with interdependent hardware-software deployments, change management spanning frontline floor staff and C-suite executives, and the constant challenge of translating cutting-edge AI into measurable value inside physical operations. You will work alongside sales, hardware engineering, software engineering, and field service teams to deliver on our promise to every client.

Requirements

Responsibilities

Lead complex, multi-site implementations. Deploy OneTrack’s integrated hardware and SaaS platform across enterprise client environments—managing hardware-software dependencies, site readiness, and go-live sequencing. Ensure every site is trained, supported, and delivering measurable value with a clear articulation of outcomes achieved.
Own long-term commercial outcomes, not just deliverables. Navigate individual engagements and full client portfolios with an eye toward the interconnected outcomes clients are driving. You are accountable for value realization—not project completion.
Build the delivery methodology and implementation playbook. Design, codify, and continuously improve our end-to-end delivery framework—covering onboarding, site activation, change management, escalation paths, and steady-state transition. Draw on best-in-class consultative frameworks to create repeatable, scalable processes that grow with the business.
Quarterback cross-functional execution. Serve as the central point of coordination across hardware, engineering, field service, and customer stakeholders. Drive timely resolution of dependencies and blockers to keep multi-workstream engagements on track.
Drive change management across every level. Ensure adoption from the warehouse floor to the executive suite. Build enablement plans that account for diverse user personas, organizational dynamics, and the realities of rolling out new technology in complex physical environments.
Monitor and optimize system performance. Track deployed sensors, hardware devices, and software telemetry. Document root causes and drive corrective actions to maintain reliability and client confidence.
Innovate with AI. Stay at the forefront of artificial intelligence and continually introduce smarter, more efficient operating practices across the implementation function.
Develop the team. Mentor and guide junior team members. Build scalable systems for tracking, reporting, and continuous improvement across the service function.

Experience & Qualifications

7+ years of experience in implementation, delivery, or engagement management within SaaS, IoT, or hardware/software hybrid environments—ideally with exposure to multi-site, enterprise-scale rollouts
Background in technology consulting, systems integration, or deploying and optimizing technology solutions in warehouse, manufacturing, logistics, or physical operations settings; familiarity with structured delivery methodologies is strongly preferred
Proven executive stakeholder management skills with experience owning C-level and VP-level relationships at enterprise clients, navigating escalations, and driving alignment across complex, multi-workstream engagements
Demonstrated experience managing people—whether direct reports or cross-functional project teams—with a track record of developing talent and scaling service functions
Proven ability to operate independently, build repeatable delivery processes from scratch, and bring structure where none exists
Highly organized, persistent in follow-through, and comfortable working in ambiguity during a high-growth stage
Bonus: Direct experience in supply chain, logistics, or warehousing technology environments

Benefits

We are predominantly located in New York and Chicago but remain open to remote employees. Compensation packages will depend on experience. Compensation will be commensurate with experience and is estimated to range from $145,000 to $165,000. The role is eligible for a performance-based cash bonus and equity awards.

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, OMHS Software, Controls, and Science
new_jobs.description:
Description

This isn't a program management role where someone else defines the problem and you track tickets to completion. You will own delivery of programs where the strategic goal is clear but the technical path forward is not. You will be the person who turns ambiguity into milestones, dependencies into action plans, and cross-team confusion into coordinated delivery.

We're deploying new automation technology to fulfillment sites quarterly. Each deployment involves software teams, controls engineers, hardware commissioning, field operations, and vendor coordination converging on a building with a ship date that does not move. Someone needs to make sure all of those pieces come together. That someone is you.

In our operating model, TPMs are assigned to programs with cross-team dependencies, not to individual products. Product managers own the what and why. Engineering leaders run their own sprints. You step in when delivery requires coordination across team boundaries, and you manage multiple programs simultaneously scoped to quarterly milestones.

You will work independently, partnering with product managers and engineering leads to scope work, establish milestones, and drive delivery. Your programs will have defined strategic goals but may not yet have clear technical solutions, and you will drive the clarity needed to move forward.

Impact at scale: The programs you manage will directly affect whether Amazon's next fulfillment buildings launch on time with functioning automation. The coordination frameworks you help establish will become the foundation for how we scale deployments from a handful of sites to dozens. Your work will be visible in buildings that are running, shipping packages, and operating reliably.

Key job responsibilities

Program Delivery Across Team Boundaries

Own planning, execution, and delivery of programs spanning multiple engineering teams and deployment organizations
Partner with product managers and engineering managers to scope work, set priorities, and establish quarterly milestones
Manage cross-team dependencies, ensuring changes in one system do not break upstream or downstream systems
Coordinate deployment activities including testing, rollout, and operational readiness for live fulfillment sites

Drive Execution Through Complexity

Establish program requirements, success metrics, and delivery timelines for programs with unclear technical solutions
Manage overall schedule, proactively mitigate risks, and keep scope under control
Drive crisp and timely decisions, clear blockers, and escalate appropriately when programs are at risk
Plan for the unexpected and ensure system maintainability is not compromised by delivery pressure

Communicate with Clarity and Purpose

Own program communications so stakeholders always have the right information at the right time
Produce clear documentation: program requirements, risk logs, milestone tracking, and stakeholder updates
Facilitate discussions that balance business urgency with technical rigor
Present program status and trade-off decisions to senior leadership

Build Better Delivery Practices

Identify opportunities to improve how cross-team programs are planned and executed
Incorporate system quality and operational excellence improvements into program plans
Run retrospectives and post-mortems that capture real learnings and drive change
Mentor peers and contribute to hiring across the team

A day in the life

Your morning starts checking in on the two programs you currently own: one is a multi-team software integration with a deployment date next quarter, the other is a hardware-software coordination effort where you're tracking vendor deliveries against commissioning windows. Mid-morning, you're running a dependency sync between two engineering teams whose changes are converging on the same system. After lunch, you're updating your risk log after discovering a potential timeline conflict and drafting an escalation path. You end your day preparing a milestone update for your stakeholder review, clearly showing what's green, what's at risk, and what help you need. Your customers are the engineering leads, product managers, and operations teams who rely on your coordination to deliver.

About The Team

We are a division within Amazon Fulfillment Technology and Robotics focused on standardizing the equipment and systems that make up our first, middle, and last mile facilities. We are a passionate group of innovators, engineers, and business leaders dedicated to reducing the variability and complacency in our current logistics systems. Our team thrives on collaboration, continuous learning, and the shared vision of developing technologies to bring innovation and scalability back to our automation equipment.

Amazon installs a significant quantity of new buildings every year. The historical model allowed each integrator to use their own equipment, controls, subsystems, and methodologies. While that enabled Amazon to succeed to this point, the variability between buildings has proven difficult to support and scale. Our charge is to build partnerships focused on consistency and scalability across the network of the future, partnering with key suppliers to help them scale manufacturing capabilities and refining designs to drive innovation, operational uptime, and better meet the specific needs of Amazon's operational environment.

Our software organization delivers the platforms, controls architecture, and AI/CV capabilities that enable Amazon to own its industrial automation ecosystem end-to-end. The product ecosystem spans machine-level controls, unified SCADA visualization, computer vision, and AI-driven design tooling, all built on a shared telemetry foundation and deployed to fulfillment sites globally.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Battelle delivers when others can’t. We conduct research and development, manage national laboratories, design and manufacture products and deliver critical services for our clients—whether they are a multi-national corporation, a small start-up or a government agency.

We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Summary

We are currently seeking a Program Manager
. This position is a full-time opportunity located on-site at Tyndall Air Force Base, near Panama City, FL.

The Program Manager will provide project management support to government programs focused on Research, Development, Test and Evaluation (RDT&E) efforts in Civil Engineer Robotic and Autonomous Systems Technologies (CERAST) in support of the U.S. Air Force Civil Engineer Center. This role sits within the Defense and Material Solutions (DMS) Business Line, National Security Business Unit, Advanced Materials and Energetics (AME) Division.

The selected candidate will build, shape, and lead the CERAST Program — directing day-to-day execution while managing cost, schedule, and technical performance. Active research areas include unmanned/autonomous systems, robotics, sensor/payload integration, rapid damage assessment, cybersecurity, RF communications, and artificial intelligence.

Responsibilities

As a Program Manager, the selected individual will lead a multidisciplinary research program supporting national security RDT&E objectives. Responsibilities may include:

Lead program teams with ultimate responsibility for meeting cost, schedule, quality, and technical/contractual performance of the CERAST program
Build upon current programs to secure new projects, guide internal investment strategy, orchestrate market engagements, and grow the program into larger markets
Manage client expectations and leverage client relationships to develop additional business opportunities
Work closely with engineering leads to ensure high-quality, mission-relevant deliverables and with Division Managers to drive execution and innovation
Establish and maintain scope, budget, and schedule baselines; report performance against those baselines and manage approved changes
Apply processes and procedures to identify, analyze, classify, prioritize, and manage program risks; formulate a risk management plan that assigns responsibility and specifies mitigation approaches and contingencies
Establish project performance metrics that ensure successful program completion
Prepare and deliver program reports and contract deliverables, including monthly status reports, financial expenditure reports, program management reviews, weekly leadership updates, and biweekly SITREPs
Integrate safety policies and regulations into the project plan, including early identification and elimination of hazards, development of program safety measures, and implementation of standard workplace safety practices
Support Battelle pipeline growth through coordination of multi-disciplinary project and proposal teams across multiple business lines and supporting teammates

Key Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience
Experience leading engineering and Research and Development programs
Experience planning and tracking projects using program management software
Experience preparing research proposals, research plans, and test plans; writing technical papers; executing RDT&E activities; and leading professional teams responsible for multiple concurrent RDT&E efforts
Experience mitigating risks through proactive management and remediation of personnel, program, client, and security issues, including tracking trends and communicating KPIs
Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET security clearance.

PMP Certification
Experience with unmanned systems, autonomous systems, and sensor/payload integration
Graduate degree (PhD preferred; master's degree plus 12 years of experience, or bachelor's degree plus 16 years of experience, may be substituted) in a field of science or engineering relevant to CERAST or airbase technologies
Minimum of 15 years of experience in RDT&E since graduation

new_jobs.title: Implementation & Technical Operations Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Axe Compute is a high-performance bare-metal infrastructure provider delivering custom, high-throughput compute solutions to enterprise workloads. In our business, delivery is the product—and world-class hardware performance must be matched by flawless operational execution, financial handoff accuracy, and strict technical change control.
Position Overview

We are seeking a high-execution, technically grounded Implementation & Technical Operations Project Manager
to own order delivery, operational handoffs, infrastructure change workflows, and billing enablement.
In addition to leading customer implementations and verifying exact delivery dates for Finance, you will serve as the operational backbone for technical change management—coordinating complex cluster upgrades, network maintenance, server inventory tracking, and cross-functional support projects alongside our NOC and Engineering teams.
Core Responsibilities

1. Order Delivery, Delivery Verification & Finance Handoff

Sales-to-Ops Handoff:
Own the post-sale handoff, verifying technical order requirements (custom hardware builds, networking setups, IP allocations) immediately upon contract execution.
Vendor & Logistics Coordination:
Partner with third-party data center operators, hardware suppliers, and internal engineering to orchestrate provisioning schedules, shipping logistics, and hot-swap/cold-spare staging.
Delivery Confirmation & Acceptance:
Formally verify and document when services are fully provisioned, tested, and turned over to the client (verifying exact Service Commencement Dates).
Finance & Billing Alignment:
Provide formal delivery sign-off documentation to Finance to trigger accurate billing cycles, ensure zero revenue leakage, and seamlessly tie operational completion to invoice activation.

2. Support Project Management & Technical Execution

Support PM:
Act as the project lead for complex, multi-stage customer support requests, custom environment modifications, and escalated technical remediations.
Cluster Upgrades & Maintenance:
Coordinate end-to-end planning and delivery for live cluster upgrades, GPU scale-outs, firmware updates, and scheduled hardware refreshes.
Network & Infrastructure Changes:
Manage logistics, communication, and execution schedules for network topology shifts, rack re-cabling, and IP transit updates.

3. Change Management & Governance

Change Control Board (CAB):
Establish and oversee formal Change Management protocols for all production maintenance, system upgrades, and network changes to protect customer SLAs.
Maintenance Windows & Notifications:
Schedule maintenance windows, align engineering resources, and draft clear, professional technical advisories for impacted clients.

4. Asset & Inventory Tracking

Inventory Management:
Maintain real-time tracking of data center hardware assets, chassis inventory, spare drive pools, switches, cabling, and hot-swap/cold-spare components across all facility locations.
Supply Chain Planning:
Monitor buffer stock levels to ensure rapid replacement turnaround and prevent provisioning bottlenecks.

Key Qualifications

Experience:
3–5+ years of experience in Technical Project Management, Infrastructure Implementation, or Technical Operations within data centers, bare-metal hosting, or cloud environments.
Finance & Ops Alignment:
Demonstrated experience managing delivery sign-offs, verifying customer acceptance, and hand-off processes with Finance/Billing teams.
Technical Breadth:
Familiarity with data center hardware, cluster architectures, IPMI/BMC, rack provisioning, network change control, and maintenance protocols.
Process Mastery:
Track record of establishing formal Change Management (CAB) workflows and tracking physical server/network inventory.
Tools & Systems:
Proficiency in project management and ITSM tools (Jira, Confluence, Asana, ServiceNow) and asset/financial management software.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Time-to-Deliver (TTD):
Days from contract execution to customer handoff/activation.
Billing Handoff Accuracy:
100% on-time delivery confirmation documentation provided to Finance to ensure billing starts on the exact day of activation.
Change Success Rate:
Percentage of planned maintenance, cluster upgrades, and network changes executed without unscheduled downtime or SLA breaches.
Inventory Accuracy:
100% visibility and reconciliation of active, spare, and in-transit hardware assets.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

Job Summary

The Cloud Innovation Centre (CIC) Project Manager leads the full lifecycle of multiple concurrent cloud innovation projects, including medium scale and technically complex initiatives involving artificial intelligence (AI), generative AI and Amazon Web Services (AWS). The role translates challenges proposed by community, government, higher education and not for profit organizations into defined projects that deliver proof of concept solutions, demonstrate feasibility and create practical learning opportunities for UBC students.

The Project Manager is accountable for project scope, plans, schedules, resource coordination, delivery risks and agreed outcomes. The position assembles multidisciplinary teams, assigns responsibilities and makes project delivery decisions within the CIC mandate, approved resources and the UBC AWS collaboration agreement. It directly supervises project assistants and leads the project work of developers, consultants, senior solutions architects and student staff. As a member of the CIC management team, the Project Manager contributes to strategic and operational planning and establishes and improves project management practices that support reliable delivery, effective partnerships and student development.

Organizational Status

The position reports to the Director and works closely with UBC and AWS CIC colleagues, senior project sponsors, technical specialists, the Office of the Provost and Vice President, Academic, Faculties, UBC IT and other academic and administrative units. The role provides project leadership across participating organizations and represents the CIC in matters concerning assigned project delivery.

Work Performed

Specific Duties:

Leads concurrent small and medium scale cloud innovation projects, including complex AI initiatives, from challenge scoping, planning and team formation through development, testing, demonstrations and project closure.
Works with sponsors, technical leads and subject matter experts to define requirements, success criteria, scope, constraints and deliverables; documents and maintains agreement on project objectives.
Develops and maintains project plans, schedules, milestones and resource requirements; assembles teams, assigns responsibilities and balances competing demands across assigned projects.
Evaluates changes to scope, schedules and resources, resolves dependencies and determines corrective action. Makes significant delivery decisions within approved parameters and escalates decisions requiring additional authority or resources to the Director.
Tracks progress, risks and issues, anticipates delays and addresses barriers to delivery. Leads sponsor reviews of project outcomes and coordinates completion of agreed deliverables and project closure.
Provides project direction to developers, designers, senior solutions architects and other specialists delivering serverless web applications, AI enabled tools and cloud solutions using AWS, infrastructure as code and related technologies.
Works with technical leads to translate architectural recommendations and development constraints into delivery plans; manages interdependencies among data preparation, AI integration, application development, testing and release activities.
Establishes project quality and validation objectives with sponsors and technical specialists. Ensures required architecture, security, development and compliance reviews are incorporated into project work and identified issues are addressed with the responsible specialists.
Manages requirements validation, testing and pilot activities; coordinates demonstrations, technical and user documentation, and handover of prototypes and supporting materials to sponsors.
Owns relationships with senior internal and external project stakeholders for assigned projects, clarifies commitments, negotiates feasible delivery expectations and resolves issues affecting scope, timing and outcomes.
Leads project meetings, sponsor discussions and progress presentations; explains technical considerations, dependencies, risks and options in terms that support informed decisions by technical and non-technical audiences.
Works with technical and communications colleagues to prepare project summaries, web content and other approved communications; coordinates sharing of project outcomes and open source materials in accordance with CIC practices.
Selects, adapts and establishes CIC project management methods, procedures, documentation and quality objectives within applicable UBC requirements and the agreed UBC AWS innovation approach.
Evaluates delivery results, lessons learned and student feedback; implements improvements to project practices, team coordination and the work integrated learning experience.
Contributes to CIC strategic and operational planning by advising on project capacity, delivery priorities, risks and improvement opportunities. Maintains appropriate professional designations and current knowledge of project management approaches and relevant cloud and AI technologies.
Mentors student and junior staff, identifies learning needs and ensures access to suitable tools, training and guidance. Balances learning opportunities with project requirements and delivery commitments.
Addresses performance concerns within supervisory authority and works with the relevant supervisor, the Director and Human Resources on matters requiring formal action.

Core Duties:

Initiates projects following appropriate project management methodology including gathering and defining project requirements, developing project charters, project plans, budgets and schedules, identifying staffing requirements, and forming project teams.
Selects and follows project management methods, procedures, and quality objectives, and tracks metrics for assessing progress.
Balances workload, provides technical and analytical guidance and work direction to project team, including scheduling, assignment of work, review of project efforts and removal of roadblocks which may inhibit project success.
Ensures that all team members have the tools and training required to perform effectively, and provides the team with constructive feedback as it pertains to project performance.
Assesses variances from the project plans, budgets and schedules, develops and implements changes as necessary to ensure that the project remains within specified scope and is within time, cost, and quality objectives, and keeps management aware of the situation.
Conducts formal review with business sponsor at project completion to confirm acceptance and satisfaction.
Identifies potential areas for improvement in current methodologies and provides guidance to other less experienced project managers.
Develops and maintains a productive working relationship with project sponsors, vendors and key clients.
Maintains appropriate professional designations and up to date knowledge of current information technology techniques and tools.
Performs other related duties as required.

Consequence of Error/Judgement

The position exercises professional judgment and works with wide latitude in decisions affecting scope, resources, schedules, quality and stakeholder commitments. These decisions influence project feasibility, CIC resources, delivery outcomes and student learning. Inadequate scoping, coordination or risk management can cause rework, additional costs, missed commitments, unusable deliverables or compliance concerns. Mishandling sensitive information can have legal and reputational consequences and undermine confidence in UBC, AWS and the CIC. The Project Manager anticipates problems, evaluates options and takes corrective action or escalates matters beyond delegated authority.

Supervision Received

Reports to the Director and receives broad direction on priorities and intended outcomes. Works with wide latitude within the CIC mandate, collaboration commitments and approved resources. Work is reviewed against broad project objectives, delivery quality and team leadership. Consults the Director on material changes or matters outside delegated authority, and works closely with technical experts and sponsors.

Supervision Given

Directly supervises project assistants and other assigned staff. Directs multidisciplinary project teams, including senior technical specialists and students, and coordinates work through designated team leads and relevant supervisors. Provides coaching, mentorship and performance feedback.

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. In-depth knowledge of applications and the business requirements supporting them. Minimum of five years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion

Preferred Qualifications

Progressive project and/or technology management experience (or an equivalent combination of education and experience). Experience in a university, higher education, or other public sector environment is highly preferred.
Proven track record operating in a project manager role specifically managing, designing, developing, and implementing IT systems or processes.
Experience with technology projects, software development, technical support, and the implementation of medium scale, complex, or enterprise level systems.
Experience in change management, budget development, financial management, and risk management.
Managerial experience (or equivalent combination of education and experience) with the ability to mentor and coach staff, act as a resource, and maintain high motivation.
Understanding of key trends and players in the IT industry particularly regarding mobile applications and digital media, alongside knowledge of IT application development methodologies, best practices, benchmarks, and "rules of thumb."
A Project Management Professional (PMP) designation is an asset.
Effective leadership, consulting, consensus building, conflict resolution, negotiation, and team building skills.
Ability to effectively facilitate groups to achieve appropriate outcomes, as well as develop and deliver effective presentations and workshops.
Ability to develop and maintain cooperative and productive working relationships with current and potential customers.
Ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and priorities while working in a fast paced environment.
Knowledge and experience with project management methodology and structure are important but the role will require being flexible, and not dogmatic.
Emotional intelligence and elevated relationship management skills are import

BUSINESS OPERATIONS MANAGER
Full-Time | In-Person | Downtown Chicago

Performance AI is hiring a Business Operations Manager to build the operating foundation required to scale a growing enterprise AI company.

This is not a traditional administrative or maintenance role. You will work closely with the COO and CEO to turn leadership priorities into accountable plans, establish company-wide operating discipline, and ensure that important commitments do not fall through the cracks.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

• Base salary: $90,000–$100,000
• Annual performance bonus: Up to 10% of base salary
• Health benefits
• 401(k)
• Paid time off and paid sick leave
• Company-paid gym membership
• No Visa sponsorships available.

This is a full-time, in-person position at Performance AI’s office in Prudential Tower in downtown Chicago.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

You will build and manage the systems that create visibility, accountability, and reliable execution across the company.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Establishing the company’s operating cadence, including leadership meetings, quarterly priorities, decision logs, KPI reviews, and action tracking.
• Translating strategic priorities into clear plans with owners, deadlines, milestones, dependencies, and risks.
• Building company-wide dashboards, executive reports, operating procedures, and accountability systems.
• Managing cross-functional initiatives and escalating blockers before they affect customers, revenue, compliance, or delivery.
• Coordinating employee onboarding, offboarding, payroll inputs, benefits administration, background checks, equipment, access, and documentation.
• Supporting SOC 2, HIPAA, privacy, security, and customer compliance programs through evidence collection, remediation tracking, and audit readiness.
• Managing contract workflows, vendor onboarding, renewals, insurance records, procurement controls, and corporate documentation.
• Coordinating invoicing, accounts receivable, vendor payments, financial reporting inputs, and external accounting providers.
• Creating consistent sales-to-implementation handoffs, customer onboarding plans, status reporting, training coordination, launch readiness, and acceptance tracking.

The role is approximately:
• 50% company operations and cross-functional execution
• 35% people, compliance, vendor, and corporate operations
• 15% customer implementation operations

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You should have:

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in business operations, program management, corporate operations, implementation operations, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience building or materially improving operating processes—not simply administering existing ones.
• Strong project-management and cross-functional execution skills.
• The ability to establish accountability across peers and senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
• Excellent written communication, documentation, reporting, and executive-summary skills.
• Strong judgment regarding what to handle independently, what requires consultation, and what must be escalated.
• The discretion required to work with employee, customer, financial, legal, security, and company-confidential information.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:

• B2B technology, enterprise software, healthcare technology, financial services, or another regulated industry.
• SOC 2, HIPAA, privacy, security, or enterprise customer compliance.
• Enterprise customer onboarding, implementation, professional services, or delivery operations.
• Contract administration, procurement, vendor due diligence, insurance, or corporate records.
• Payroll, billing, accounts receivable, or month-end coordination.
• Working directly with founders and senior executives.

YOU WILL SUCCEED HERE IF YOU

• Take ownership and consistently close loops.
• Bring structure to fast-moving situations without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.
• Challenge unclear ownership, unrealistic deadlines, and hidden risks directly and professionally.
• Identify problems early and recommend practical solutions.
• Move comfortably between strategy and detailed execution.
• Prefer measurable results, documented decisions, and clear accountability over activity for its own sake.
• Keep leadership informed before problems become surprises.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first 90 days, you will be expected to:

• Establish a company-wide priority tracker and leadership operating cadence.
• Create a master calendar of critical corporate, HR, legal, compliance, insurance, vendor, and customer obligations.
• Centralize contracts, vendor records, policies, insurance documents, and corporate records.
• Standardize employee onboarding and offboarding.
• Implement a compliance and operational risk register.
• Establish a repeatable sales-to-implementation handoff and customer onboarding process.
• Present a prioritized 12-month business operations roadmap.

WHY JOIN PERFORMANCE AI

You will have the opportunity to:

• Build the operating foundation of a growing enterprise AI company.
• Work directly with the COO and CEO on issues affecting customers, revenue, compliance, and scale.
• Shape how the company plans, communicates, documents decisions, and executes.
• Operate at the intersection of AI, enterprise technology, regulated industries, and business transformation.
• Grow toward a Director of Business Operations position as the company scales and your performance supports the expansion.

LOCATION REQUIREMENT

Candidates must currently live within commuting distance of downtown Chicago or independently relocate before their start date. Relocation assistance is not available.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT

Performance AI is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.

How To apply?

Please send your resume at: shair@getperformance.ai

Work Schedule:

Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

The Opportunity

Ally is seeking a Physical Security Event & Travel Risk Intelligence Manager to join our Physical Security organization to support delivering proactive and real-time intelligence for high-visibility Ally sponsored events and executive engagements.

In this role, you will partner closely with Travel & Entertainment, Marketing, Executive Protection, and Physical Security Intelligence teams to assess risk, monitor threats, and ensure the safety of employees and leadership during corporate events. You will be responsible for conducting threat intelligence analysis, supporting event planning through risk assessments, and developing emergency action plans (EAPs) that address employee and executive exposure.

This role also plays a critical role in supporting Executive Protection, providing ongoing intelligence and situational awareness for the CEO and other executives during Ally sponsored events, travel, and public-facing activities.

This is a 24/7, event-driven role that requires flexibility to support evolving threats and real-time operational needs. Candidates must be willing to work non-traditional hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, and respond to live security or life safety incidents as they arise.

As the Physical Security Event & Travel Risk Intelligence Manager, you will lead intelligence efforts tied to corporate and executive events, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, and mitigated through proactive planning and real-time support.

The Work Itself

Monitor open-source intelligence (OSINT), social media, and threat intelligence feeds for emerging risks that could impact events

Build dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide visibility to leadership
Translate data into insights and recommendations for operational improvement
Continuously evolve threat detection, monitoring practices, and reporting standards

Ensure consistency in decision-making, escalation, and reporting quality

Demonstrated ability to make independent decisions in fast-paced, ambiguous situations to assess threats and risks in dynamic environments
Experience supporting executive protection programs, corporate sponsored events, or other large-scale events
Background building and managing physical security programs
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical teams
Familiarity with incident response, crisis management, and physical security practices
Experience utilizing threat intelligence monitoring tools
Strong OSINT monitoring capabilities, threat assessment, travel risk analysis, and the ability to identify and triage emerging threats and produce actionable intelligence products
Excellent verbal & written communication skills for executive-level communication
Experience working with cross-functional teams and leaders across many levels of management
Working independently in an unstructured environment; developing structure and clarity around the ambiguous by taking a concept and developing ideas/about solutions to achieve progress
Navigating through complex collaborative initiatives while aligning
Strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, attention to detail, source validation skills, situational awareness, and the ability to remain calm under pressure
Proven ability developing trusted partnerships in both public & private sectors

Job Introduction

Role Purpose

The Fraud and Financial Crime Investigations Manager is responsible for identifying and investigating suspected criminal, fraudulent and dishonest activity affecting the business, its customers and colleagues.

The role will manage investigations from initial identification through to conclusion, seeking, gathering and assessing evidence, identifying patterns of offending, conducting interviews where appropriate and producing clear investigation reports. The Investigations Manager will work closely with store teams, Loss Prevention, Employee Relations and other internal stakeholders, as well as external agencies where required.

A key focus of the position is moving beyond individual incidents to identify repeat offenders, organised activity, emerging crime trends and weaknesses in processes or controls that may expose the business to further loss.

Key Responsibilities

Investigations

Conduct thorough investigations into suspected internal and external retail crime, fraud and dishonest activity which may include theft and attempted theft, employee dishonesty and internal fraud, refund, return and exchange abuse, discount, loyalty or promotional abuse and abuse of company processes or systems for financial gain
Manage investigations from initial allegation or intelligence through to conclusion
Review available evidence including CCTV, transaction records, till activity, payment information, access records, delivery information and relevant business records
Establish clear investigation timelines and identify links between incidents, individuals, transactions and locations
Conduct investigative interviews and obtain relevant accounts or statements in line with company procedures
Maintain clear, accurate and professional investigation records
Produce concise investigation reports setting out the evidence, findings and recommended next steps
Ensure investigations are proportionate, objective and evidence led

Evidence & Case Management

Gather, assess and preserve evidence appropriately
Maintain comprehensive investigation files and clear audit trails
Ensure case records accurately document investigative decisions and actions
Handle sensitive information with appropriate confidentiality
Prepare investigation material suitable for internal disciplinary or criminal justice processes where required
Support requests for evidence from law enforcement or other authorised external bodies in accordance with company procedures

Intelligence & Crime Prevention

Use internal systems to identify suspicious transactions and behaviour that require further investigation
Identify repeat offenders, linked incidents and emerging methods of offending
Analyse investigation information to identify trends, vulnerabilities and potential control weaknesses
Share relevant intelligence with operational teams and other appropriate stakeholders
Identify opportunities to prevent recurrence and recommend improvements to processes or controls

Stakeholder & External Partnership

Build effective working relationships with store management, Loss Prevention, Employee Relations, Legal, Security and operational teams
Liaise professionally with police and other relevant external agencies where appropriate.
Provide investigative advice and guidance to colleagues
Communicate complex investigation findings clearly to both operational and senior stakeholders
Support the business in understanding emerging retail crime and fraud risks through training and communication

The ideal candidate

Essential

Experience in retail investigations, loss prevention, fraud investigation, security, law enforcement or a comparable investigative environment
Strong investigative and analytical skills
Ability to assess information objectively and distinguish evidence from assumption
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify connections across multiple incidents or data sources
Experience producing clear written investigation reports
Confident communication and interviewing skills, Wicklander-Zulawski trained an advantage
Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately
Strong organisational and case-management skills
Ability to manage multiple investigations and competing priorities
Sound judgement and confidence when making evidence-based recommendations

Desirable

Experience investigating internal fraud or employee dishonesty
Experience of investigations involving high-value retail environments
Knowledge of payment fraud, refund abuse, organised retail crime or ecommerce fraud
Experience working with CCTV and transaction-monitoring data
Experience liaising with police or other external agencies, including writing of MG11s and exhibiting of appropriate evidence

new_jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

INTELLIGENCE ANALYST

SpaceX is seeking a dynamic and driven individual with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as a member of a team in a fast-paced, high-tech environment. Our goal is to protect some of the world’s most advanced technologies, including rockets, Dragon capsules for human transport, inter-planetary transport vehicles, the world's largest satellite communications network, etc. As an industry leader, we attract foreign and domestic adversaries intent on impeding our progress and stealing our technology. The work we do will safeguard mankind as we become an interplanetary species.

You will be responsible for the research, analysis, production, and dissemination of information relevant to protecting the security of personnel, global assets, and operations at SpaceX. You will use various collection methods and platforms to explore data, identify critical information, build queries, and assess risk to produce actional insights that drive informed business decisions.

Responsibilities

Conduct in-depth research, evaluation, analysis, integration, and interpretation of information sourced from various open sources.
Produce high-quality intelligence products on a daily, weekly, and monthly cadence, including data visualization, briefings, and analytic reports.
Perform enhanced due diligence on companies and people within established tradecraft standards.
Utilize data aggregators and OSINT tools to conduct open-source research, and leverage social media platforms, deep web, dark web, and breach data to identify hidden connections.
Identify emerging risks to the company, our technology, and people and quickly synthesize information to share with relevant stakeholders.
Communicate findings effectively and accurately to team members, leadership, and relevant stakeholders.
Facilitate information sharing by fostering relationships and partnering with internal stakeholders as well as external local and federal law enforcement.
Conduct intelligence analysis, threat assessments, and investigations on persons, companies, and organizations of interest.
Develop risk mitigation strategies to address identified and work with internal teams to implement them.
Manage and safeguard sensitive information, including case file and intelligence reports.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of professional experience in intelligence analysis, enhanced due diligence (EDD), third party risk management (TPRM), supply chain risk management (SCRM), and/or investigations; OR 4+ years of professional experience in the aforementioned areas in lieu of a degree.

Preferred Skills And Experience

2+ years of all-source intelligence experience in the military, intelligence community, federal law enforcement, or in the private sector at a high-tech company and/or US Government contractor.
Familiarity with trade compliance regulations and restrictions, including export controls (ITAR, EAR, etc.) and import controls.
Experience supporting trade compliance and/or supply chain teams and implementing TPRM and Denied Party Screening programs.
Experience with open-source intelligence gathering tools/techniques for application/web-based social media platforms including web scraping, data parsing, and metadata extraction.
Experience performing business process automation, constructing data pipelines, building dashboards, and developing robust queries and AI prompts.
Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with security and engineering teams on technical topics. This includes maintaining conceptual understandings of foundational topics related to data structures, databases, APIs, network infrastructure, and access controls.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze large data sets and draw actionable insights.
Knowledge of analytic tradecraft standards, source validation, and disinformation detection.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to produce clear and concise research reports and briefings for a wide variety of internal and external audiences.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment in a fast-paced, high-tech environment.
Highly organized with a strong attention to detail.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
High degree of emotional intelligence and maturity.
Strong critical thinking skills and a solutions-oriented mindset.

Additional Requirements

Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support critical efforts and operations.
Must be willing to travel ad hoc, although only minimal travel is expected at this time.
Active TS/SCI clearance, or ability to obtain one. With an active clearance, candidates will be subject to pre-employment screening including background check and drug/alcohol test as well as random drug and alcohol testing during employment.

Compensation And Benefits

Pay Range:

Level 1: $85,000 - $110,000

Level 2: $100,000 - $135,000

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

Itar Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

new_jobs.title: AI Data Analyst - Merchant Acquisition
new_jobs.description:
About Us

We are an established Independent Sales Organization with seven years of experience in the credit-card-processing and merchant-services industry. We understand how merchants evaluate processors, why they consider switching, the objections they raise and the factors that ultimately drive conversion.

We are building a proprietary, AI-driven lead-intelligence platform to identify and prioritize merchants most likely to become customers. Our goal is to combine our industry knowledge, current sales-call recordings, operational information and external business data into a system that makes prospecting more scientific, targeted and measurable.

We are seeking an entrepreneurial data-science leader to design and lead this initiative from research and prototype development through prospective testing and commercialization.

The Opportunity

This is not a conventional data-science position in which a completed dataset and predefined model are handed to you. You will help determine what data matters, how it should be collected and labeled, and how qualitative sales intelligence can be transformed into quantitative predictions.

Because our historical labeled data is limited, the initial work will include analyzing current sales-call recordings, interviewing members of our sales organization and identifying the characteristics, circumstances and behaviors associated with merchants who are receptive to switching processors.

The successful candidate will build an initial lead-scoring methodology, test it against real-world sales results and continuously improve it as new outcome data is generated.

This is a founding-level opportunity with salary and equity participation in the resulting platform. The right candidate will have substantial autonomy and the opportunity to create a potentially valuable commercial product within an established operating business.

Responsibilities

Develop the overall research, data and AI strategy for a proprietary merchant lead-intelligence platform.
Analyze recorded sales conversations using transcription, natural-language processing, large language models and human-reviewed qualitative research.
Create a structured framework for extracting relevant information from calls, including merchant characteristics, processing concerns, switching triggers, objections, urgency, decision-maker engagement and sales outcomes.
Interview sales representatives and company leadership to capture domain knowledge that may not appear in existing structured data.
Design reliable labeling and quality-control procedures for call transcripts and sales outcomes.
Identify the signals most likely to predict meaningful sales progression, including statement submissions, follow-up meetings, proposals and signed merchant accounts.
Develop an initial transparent, rules-based scoring model suitable for use while labeled data remains limited.
Progressively develop statistical and machine-learning models as sufficient prospective data becomes available.
Identify and evaluate external data sources that could reveal merchant size, growth, industry, number of locations, technology, ownership changes, hiring activity and other relevant characteristics.
Connect internal conversation insights to externally observable business signals that can be used to identify new prospects.
Design controlled sales experiments comparing AI-selected leads with leads selected through our existing process.
Establish appropriate performance metrics, including conversion lift, precision among top-ranked leads, customer-acquisition cost and expected merchant profitability.
Work with sales leadership to integrate lead recommendations into the company’s existing workflow.
Build or manage the development of an initial working prototype and subsequent production platform.
Develop appropriate documentation, data-governance practices and safeguards for sensitive sales and merchant information.
Help evaluate and recruit additional data, engineering or research talent as the project grows.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to business leadership and nontechnical sales personnel.

Required Qualifications

Advanced training or equivalent professional experience in data science, applied statistics, machine learning, computer science, econometrics, quantitative marketing or a closely related field.
Demonstrated experience with predictive modeling, propensity modeling, lead scoring, customer analytics or another classification/ranking problem.
Strong Python and SQL capabilities.
Experience working with unstructured text, call transcripts, conversation analytics or natural-language processing.
Familiarity with large language models and their use in structured information extraction, classification and research workflows.
Ability to work effectively with limited historical data and develop a disciplined data-collection and validation plan.
Understanding of experimental design, prospective validation, model evaluation and common problems such as data leakage, overfitting and selection bias.
Ability to combine qualitative business research with quantitative analysis.
Strong product judgment and an interest in building a commercial platform, not merely producing an academic model or research report.
Ability to work independently, define priorities and communicate directly with company leadership.
High standards for confidentiality, security and responsible handling of recorded conversations and merchant information.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in merchant acquiring, credit-card processing, payments, fintech, banking or financial services.
Experience analyzing B2B sales calls or developing sales-intelligence, revenue-operations or customer-acquisition systems.
Familiarity with merchant categories, processing statements, pricing structures, interchange, chargebacks, point-of-sale systems and the reasons merchants change processors.
Experience with speech-to-text systems, embeddings, retrieval systems and LLM evaluation.
Experience combining internal company data with licensed or publicly available external business data.
Experience taking a data product from initial research through deployment and ongoing monitoring.
Previous startup, founding-team or entrepreneurial experience.
Experience managing technical contributors or outside development resources.

Initial Objectives

During the first several months, the successful candidate will be expected to:

Audit the information currently available, including sales-call recordings, CRM information and business outcomes.
Interview company leadership and high-performing sales representatives.
Develop a taxonomy for merchant needs, dissatisfaction, switching triggers, objections and levels of sales progression.
Build and validate an AI-assisted process for transcribing, reviewing and structuring sales conversations.
Produce an initial rules-based lead-scoring system based on qualitative and quantitative evidence.
Recommend external data sources and determine which observable merchant characteristics can support prospect identification.
Design a prospective experiment comparing prioritized leads with the company’s current lead-selection process.
Deliver a working prototype and a roadmap for developing a defensible production platform.

What Success Looks Like

Success Will Not Be Measured By Producing An Impressive Demonstration Or Using The Newest AI Technology. It Will Be Measured By Whether The System Consistently Helps Our Sales Organization

Reach more qualified decision-makers.
Identify merchants with genuine reasons to reconsider their current processor.
Obtain more processing statements and substantive follow-up meetings.
Generate more proposals from the same amount of sales activity.
Improve close rates and merchant profitability.
Explain why particular leads are being prioritized.
Learn and improve as additional sales outcomes are generated.

Why Join Us

Join an established ISO with seven years of merchant-services experience and real industry knowledge.
Lead a strategically important initiative with direct access to company decision-makers and sales personnel.
Build a proprietary AI and data product around an identifiable commercial need.
Receive a competitive salary together with meaningful equity participation.
Work remotely with substantial autonomy.
Have the opportunity to develop the project into a broader commercial platform.

Salary

Candidates will be paid a competitive salary based on experience. Expected pay range is $70-80,000 per year. This position is full time and eligible for full benefits package as well.

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Senior Data Analyst – Strategic & Program Analytics

Location:
Dallas, TX | Hybrid or Remote
Compensation:
$100–140k Base Salary

A mission-driven organization in Dallas is looking for Senior Data Analysts
to join a growing Strategic Analytics function focused on using data to tackle some of the city's most complex social challenges.

This organization works at the intersection of data, public policy, healthcare, housing, education, criminal justice, and community programs
, partnering with public agencies and community organizations to turn evidence into action. The broader mission is ambitious and measurable: helping dramatically reduce child poverty across Dallas by improving how public resources and programs reach children and families.

These are not traditional reporting or dashboard-focused analyst positions. We're looking for people who can take broad, ambiguous real-world questions
, determine what can legitimately be answered with the available data, conduct rigorous analysis, and translate their findings into recommendations that leaders can actually act on.

The Opportunities

There are multiple openings across two types of Senior Data Analyst roles:

Senior Data Analyst – Strategy

You'll operate as a cross-functional analytical problem solver, working on questions that may come directly from city officials, agency leaders, foundations, and internal leadership.

One week you might be investigating where eligible families aren't accessing public benefits; another could involve understanding geographic gaps in healthcare access, patterns in school attendance, housing affordability, or public safety.

This role leans heavily into statistics, public and administrative data, and analytical judgment
. You'll need to understand not only how to perform an analysis, but whether the available data can actually support the conclusion someone wants to draw. The underlying JD specifically emphasizes regression, sampling and weighting, hypothesis testing, missing data, and understanding the limitations of estimates.

Senior Data Analyst – Program

You'll embed with a specific program area such as housing, maternal health, public safety, benefits delivery, or criminal justice
, becoming that team's dedicated analytics partner.

You'll learn the program's strategy, stakeholders, and recurring decisions, then use data to help the team understand what's happening, why it matters, and where resources or interventions may have the greatest impact.

Both roles involve working heavily with messy, real-world datasets
, with much of the information coming from publicly available sources and administrative data rather than perfectly structured internal systems.

What You'll Do:

Turn ambiguous stakeholder requests into clearly defined, answerable analytical questions.
Source, combine, clean, and analyze public, administrative, and internal datasets.
Evaluate data quality, missingness, sampling issues, outliers, margins of error, and other limitations before drawing conclusions.
Apply statistical methods such as regression, hypothesis testing, sampling, and weighting
where appropriate.
Identify confounding factors and clearly communicate what the data does and does not
support.
Build clean, reproducible analytical workflows using R, Python, Stata, or similar tools
.
Translate complex findings into concise recommendations, decision memos, and visuals for non-technical stakeholders.
Partner directly with program leaders, public agencies, and community stakeholders to influence resource allocation, program design, and strategy.
Use AI-assisted tools across research, coding, and QA while independently validating the methodology and final conclusions.

What We're Looking For:

3–4+ years of applied analytical experience
solving real-world business, policy, research, healthcare, consulting, or program-related problems.
Strong statistical foundations and the judgment to determine which analytical approach is appropriate — and when the data isn't strong enough to support a conclusion.
Hands-on experience working with messy, complex datasets
, ideally including public, administrative, healthcare, policy, demographic, or other real-world data.
Fluency in at least one analytical programming language such as R, Python, or Stata
.
Experience creating reproducible, well-documented analytical workflows.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly translating technical analysis for non-technical decision-makers.
A consultative mindset: you're comfortable receiving an unclear question, figuring out what the stakeholder actually needs to know, and independently determining how to answer it.

Responsibilities

The Account, Search & Interaction Safety Team is a lean and agile group focused on safeguarding user interactions across Account, Search, Comment, and Messaging. Our mission is to respond quickly to evolving safety challenges by streamlining workflows, implementing efficient operational processes, and fostering cross team collaboration to proactively address risks.

The planning team ensures that safety operations are adequately resourced, optimized, and future-ready. By aligning workforce supply with business needs, managing vendors and internal capacity, and responding to real-time changes, the team plays a central role in maintaining service levels, productivity, and long term scalability of safety operations.

Responsibilities:
Moderation Queue & Management
- Own the end-to-end configuration of moderation queues, including creation, permission management, queue settings, policy collection binding, enqueue issue monitoring and completion monitoring to ensure smooth task distribution and governance. Seek tooling optimization for more feasible and efficient queue settings.

Efficiency Metrics Optimization
- Monitor and analyze key operational efficiency indicators such as Average Handling Time (AHT) and Utilization Rate (UR). Identify inefficiencies, surface trends, and recommend improvement actions to optimize productivity and maintain quality standards.

Project Readiness & Staffing for New Launches
- Ensure timely workforce readiness for new product or policy launches. Plan ramp-up timelines, align with training teams, and validate staffing sufficiency to meet forecasted volumes and SLA expectations.

Real-time Workforce Monitoring & Saturation Alerts
- Monitor active staffing levels and queue capacity to detect early signs of resource saturation. Provide timely warnings and mitigation strategies (e.g., reallocation, overtime, or temp staffing) to prevent operational bottlenecks.

Scenario Planning & Contingency Management
- Conduct scenario-based planning to account for potential volume surges, platform changes, or crisis events. Develop contingency plans to safeguard moderation continuity and maintain SLAs.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication
- Work closely with Product Ops, Vendor Management, QA, and Policy teams to align capacity plans with evolving business priorities and ensure shared visibility into staffing risks and mitigation plans.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or above in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- At least 2 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, or product operations.
- Familiarity with metrics system design, attribution analysis, and goal-setting methodologies.
- Proficient in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), SQL, Excel, and statistical analysis tools.

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders.

At Delta Air Lines, connection is at the heart of everything we do and guides our every action.
